applicationArchitecture: Java + XML / MVVM + Repository + Model / Firebase Android SDK; no separate backend

checks: Guest submits real server-timestamped report idempotently; forged owner and self-resolution denied
Read state persists on Firestore; another account cannot read report/receipt or write peer receipt
Admin conclusion requires reason; server reviewer/time and audit are saved atomically; repeat resolution rejected
Offline report transaction fails and creates no document; UI cannot show an acknowledged success
Moderation suspends only QA room or blocks only QA Host with synchronized public status; original owners/bookings untouched

scopeExceptions: Payment/refund integration remains unavailable by user decision; no fabricated PAID or refund confirmation.
Private evidence image/PDF storage is deferred.
No FCM/background push; in-app updates and opt-in local notifications only.
Inbox represents current booking states and latest conversation previews, not immutable event history.
Nearby results are supported categories filtered from at most 10 nearest MapTiler POIs within 1 km, not an exhaustive directory.
Map client keys are extractable from the APK; provider quota/key permissions remain necessary.
Host report reply UI from the parallel member branch has not been merged; its deployed Rules contract was preserved.
No physical-device performance benchmark or Android 13 notification-permission acceptance in this phase.
